During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched a series of '''attacks''' on the financial world of [[Circarpous IV]]. The attacks were an attempt to undermine the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] economy, just as the Republic tried to undermine the Separatist economy with repeated assaults on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].
